description: This file defines a mock class 'SessionServerManagerMock' for the 'ISessionServerManager' interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto server service component. It includes mock method declarations for initializing, starting service, setting configuration and state, setting log levels, and pinging, which are typical for managing a session server in a media or application server context.
